page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data.

With dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides predictable compute performance for its scale, though it lacks advanced vector and matrix extensions such as AVX-512 or AMX, as well as hardware-assisted cryptography acceleration. The absence of local NVMe storage means all I/O operations rely on network-attached storage, which introduces network latency considerations for disk-heavy operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density relative to the low vCPU count makes this instance suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel processing power. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and memory-intensive background utilities that operate efficiently within a dual-core envelope.
